item.title: China factory explosion kills eight
item.description: An explosion at a biotech factory in northern China has killed eight people, Chinese state media reported Sunday, increasing the total number of fatalities by one. item.description: ISLAMABAD: The Pakistan Bureau of Emigration and Overseas Employment has warned jobseekers to remain vigilant against fraudulent overseas employment offers, particularly those involving upfront payment demands.
